```{r}
library(readxl)
lunch_money <- read_excel("fa7.xlsx")
names(lunch_money)
mean(lunch_money$`Lunch Money`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(lunch_money$`Lunch Money`, na.rm = TRUE)
table(cut(lunch_money$`Lunch Money`, breaks = 5))

# Plotting
hist(lunch_money$`Lunch Money`, probability = TRUE, col = "lightblue", main = "Normal Distribution of Lunch Money", xlab = "Money Allotted")
curve(dnorm(x, mean = 165, sd = 66.43), add = TRUE, col = "red", lwd = 2)

money <- lunch_money$`Lunch Money`
m <- 165
s <- 66.43

# 1 Standard Deviation
cat("Percentage within 1 SD:", mean(money >= (m - s) & money <= (m + s)) * 100, "%\n")

# 2 Standard Deviations
cat("Percentage within 2 SD:", mean(money >= (m - 2*s) & money <= (m + 2*s)) * 100, "%\n")

# 3 Standard Deviations
cat("Percentage within 3 SD:", mean(money >= (m - 3*s) & money <= (m + 3*s)) * 100, "%\n")

```
